exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one foot off the floor by raising your knee toward your chest in a marching motion. Alternate legs in a controlled manner, maintaining a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Internal/External Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor, keeping the other leg straight and relaxed. Rest your arms at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently rotate the bent knee inward and outward through a comfortable range of motion, allowing the hip to rotate naturally. Move slowly and stop before any pain or significant resistance.

exercises.name: Supine Iliopsoas Stretch
exercises.pose_description: A person lies supine on a treatment table with their back flat, positioned towards the edge. One knee is bent and pulled towards the chest, held by both hands clasped over the shin. The opposite leg hangs straight down off the edge of the table, with the thigh extending below the table's surface.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person lies supine on their back with one knee pulled tightly to their chest (hip and knee flexed at approximately 90 degrees), held by both hands, while the opposite leg hangs vertically off the edge of the surface with the hip extended and knee slightly bent, creating a deep stretch through the front of the hip and thigh. The lower back remains pressed flat against the surface, the torso is stable and centered, and the hanging leg's thigh drops noticeably below the horizontal plane of the bed or table.

exercises.name: Supine Lower Trunk Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides for balance and stability.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently lower both knees to one side, allowing controlled rotation of your lower spine and pelvis. Keep your shoulders flat on the floor and return to center before rotating the other direction.

exercises.name: Supine Marching
exercises.pose_description: Lying flat on back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. One knee lifts toward the chest to approximately 90 degrees of hip flexion while the opposite foot remains on the floor. The legs alternate in a slow marching motion, and the lower back stays pressed against the floor with the core engaged throughout.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person lies flat on their back with one knee lifted toward the chest at approximately 90 degrees of hip flexion while the opposite leg remains extended with the foot flat on the floor; the lower back is pressed firmly against the floor and the abdominal muscles appear visibly engaged and contracted. The lifted knee is directly above the hip joint, the arms rest at the sides or across the chest for stability, and the head remains neutral against the floor.

exercises.name: Supine Passive Range of Motion
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Your affected arm is at your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees and palm facing up.
exercises.end_pose_description: Using your opposite hand or a light grip on your affected arm, gently guide your forearm across your body and toward the opposite side. The movement is controlled and pain-free, allowing gravity to assist the stretch.

exercises.name: Supine Pelvic Tilt
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Your arms rest at your sides with palms down.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently tilt your pelvis to flatten your lower back against the floor by engaging your abdominal muscles. Hold this neutral spine position for a few seconds before releasing.

exercises.name: Supine Piriformis Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lying flat on back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. One ankle crosses over the opposite knee in a figure-four position. Both hands reach through the gap and clasp behind the thigh of the bottom leg, pulling it toward the chest. A deep stretch is felt in the outer hip and glute of the crossed leg.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person lies flat on their back with the bottom leg pulled toward the chest at approximately 90 degrees at the hip, while the top leg's ankle remains crossed over the bottom knee in a figure-four position with the hip externally rotated. The glutes and outer hip of the crossed leg appear fully engaged and stretched, with visible tension in the piriformis. Both shoulders remain flat on the ground, and the head stays neutral or slightly tilted to either side.

exercises.name: Supine Quad Sets
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Place a small towel roll under the knee of the affected leg.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tighten the quadriceps muscle on the front of the thigh, straightening the knee and lifting the heel slightly off the floor. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Blade Squeezes
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down toward your hips, holding the contraction for 2 seconds without lifting your arms off the floor. Return to the starting position and repeat in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back on a firm surface with both arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your core engaged and press your lower back gently into the surface.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly slide both arms overhead along the surface, moving them toward the floor above your head as far as comfortable without pain. Return to the starting position and repeat.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding a resistance band with both hands at your chest level. Your arms are bent at 90 degrees with the band taut.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly extend your arms overhead in a controlled manner, keeping the band under tension throughout the movement. Your arms are extended above your chest at the end, moving only as far as comfort allows.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Light Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a light dumbbell (2-3 lbs) in your affected hand with your arm at your side, elbow slightly bent.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly raise the dumbbell overhead in a controlled arc, moving only at the shoulder joint. Stop at a comfortable range that does not cause pain, typically around 90 degrees of shoulder flexion.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Pulley
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a light dumbbell or medicine ball in your affected arm with elbow slightly bent at your side.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly raise your affected arm overhead in a controlled arc, keeping the elbow slightly bent throughout the movement. Lower back to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Supine Thoracic Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with your knees bent and dropped to one side, keeping both shoulders pressed into the floor. Extend both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms facing up.
exercises.end_pose_description: Drop both knees to one side while keeping your shoulders flat on the floor and upper back engaged. Feel the stretch along your thoracic spine.

exercises.name: Supported Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.target_area: Lower Back, Thoracic Spine & Shoulder Mobility
exercises.pose_description: On hands and knees with a yoga block or cushion under the hands for wrist support, or with forearms on a chair seat for reduced wrist loading. The spine alternates between arching downward with the chest lifting and belly dropping (cow) and rounding upward with the chin tucking and tailbone curling under (cat). The movements are slow and synchronized with breathing.
exercises.end_pose_description: At the peak of the cat phase, the spine is maximally rounded with the upper back arched toward the ceiling, shoulders hunched upward, chin tucked toward the chest, and tailbone curled under; the arms remain straight or slightly bent (supporting on hands or forearms depending on modification), knees are bent at 90 degrees on the ground, and the entire posterior chain from neck to pelvis appears engaged and contracted upward. The head hangs naturally with gaze directed downward, and the abdominal muscles are visibly engaged as the torso forms an inverted U-shape.

exercises.name: Swimmers Exercise
exercises.pose_description: The person lies prone on the floor with arms extended straight overhead, palms facing down. Legs are extended straight behind them, and the head is in a neutral alignment with the spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person lies face-down in a prone position with one arm extended overhead at approximately 160-170 degrees and the opposite leg lifted 6-12 inches off the ground, both fully extended and straight, while the other arm and leg remain lowered, creating a diagonal opposition line through the body. The torso stays relatively flat against the ground, the head remains neutral in line with the spine facing downward, and the engaged back muscles (erector spinae, latissimus dorsi) and glutes on the lifted side appear visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Tandem Stance (Heel-to-Toe)
exercises.pose_description: Stand with one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, with arms at your sides or extended for balance. Shift your weight evenly between both feet.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hold this narrow tandem stance while focusing on a point ahead, engaging your ankle stabilizers and core. Your ankle makes constant micro-adjustments to maintain balance in this challenging position.

exercises.name: Tendon Gliding Exercises
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your right hand relaxed and fingers extended on a table surface. Keep your wrist in a neutral position throughout the exercise.
exercises.end_pose_description: Progress through hook fist, straight fist, and full fist positions, holding each for 1-2 seconds. This exercise helps flexor tendons move freely and prevents adhesions.

exercises.name: Tennis Ball Roll
exercises.pose_description: Seated in a chair with one foot resting on a tennis ball placed on the floor. Gentle downward pressure is applied through the foot as it rolls the ball from the toes to the heel and across the arch, massaging the plantar fascia. The opposite foot remains flat on the floor, and the body weight shifts slightly to increase or decrease pressure.
exercises.end_pose_description: The seated figure has their working foot rolled back toward the heel with the tennis ball positioned under the arch, knee bent at approximately 90 degrees while the opposite leg remains extended with foot flat on the floor. The torso remains upright and centered in the chair, with visible engagement through the calf and foot musculature as body weight presses downward through the rolling foot, creating tension across the plantar fascia and arch area.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension
exercises.pose_description: Standing with a resistance band looped behind the knee, anchored to a fixed point behind the body. The knee starts in a slightly bent position, approximately 20 to 30 degrees of flexion. The leg presses forward and straightens fully against the band resistance, achieving complete knee extension. The standing leg and torso remain upright.
exercises.end_pose_description: The working leg is fully extended straight ahead with the knee locked in complete extension (0 degrees of flexion), while the standing leg remains straight and stable supporting the upright torso. The quadriceps of the extended leg appear visibly contracted and engaged, with the resistance band stretched taut behind the knee. The person faces forward with shoulders square and neutral spine alignment.

exercises.name: Thoracic Extension
exercises.pose_description: Standing upright or seated in a chair with hands clasped behind the head. The upper back gently arches backward, extending through the thoracic spine while the lumbar spine stays relatively neutral. The elbows pull back and the chest lifts toward the ceiling, opening the front of the body. The movement is controlled and focused on the mid-back region.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person stands upright with their upper back maximally extended backward, chest lifted and opened toward the ceiling, while their hands remain clasped behind their head with elbows pulled back and wide. The thoracic spine displays a pronounced backward curve while the lower back stays neutral, creating visible engagement across the mid-back, rear shoulders, and chest muscles that appear stretched and extended.

exercises.name: Thoracic Spine Rotation - Seated
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and arms crossed over chest with hands behind head. Keep your hips and lower back still against the chair.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your upper torso to one side, feeling a stretch across the mid-back and ribcage. Hold the rotation while maintaining an upright posture.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Start on hands and knees with neutral spine and shoulders over wrists. Place one hand behind your head with elbow pointing out.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your thoracic spine, bringing your elbow toward the opposite knee while following with your gaze. Feel the stretch across your upper back and shoulders.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.pose_description: On hands and knees in tabletop position. One arm threads underneath the body, reaching through the space between the opposite arm and knee, with the shoulder and temple resting on the floor. The hips remain over the knees, and the supporting arm may stay straight or bend slightly. A deep rotation stretch is felt through the thoracic spine and shoulder.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is in a deep spinal rotation with the right shoulder and right temple pressed flat against the floor, the right arm fully threaded underneath the torso with the palm facing up, while the left arm remains straight and supporting the upper body weight. The hips stay squared over the knees in a kneeling position, and the head is turned to face downward toward the floor with the spine twisted maximally through the thoracic region, creating visible tension through the shoulder blade, obliques, and upper back muscles.

exercises.name: Thumb Abduction with Band Resistance
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down with fingers relaxed. A resistance band is looped around your thumb and index finger.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull your thumb away from your index finger against the band resistance, creating a 45-degree angle. Hold this position briefly before returning to start.

exercises.name: Thumb Flexor Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with one arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing up. Use your opposite hand to gently hold your thumb.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently pull your thumb backward and downward toward the inside of your wrist, creating a comfortable stretch along the thumb's base. Hold steady without forcing the movement.

exercises.name: Toe Curls with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the ground and a light resistance band looped around all five toes. Your foot is relaxed with toes extended.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl all your toes downward against the resistance of the band, engaging the intrinsic foot muscles. Hold briefly before returning to the extended position.

exercises.name: Toe Raises
exercises.pose_description: Standing upright with feet hip-width apart, lightly holding a wall or chair for balance. The toes and forefoot lift off the ground while the heels remain planted, dorsiflexing the ankles and engaging the tibialis anterior. The body weight shifts slightly back onto the heels, and the torso stays upright.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person stands upright with heels firmly planted on the ground and toes/forefoot lifted as high as possible, creating a pronounced dorsiflexion angle at the ankles (approximately 45-60 degrees). The shins appear visibly tense with the tibialis anterior muscles clearly engaged and defined, while the calves are stretched and elongated. The torso remains perfectly vertical and stable, with the person's weight noticeably shifted back onto their heels.

exercises.name: Toe Taps with Foot Elevated
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with one leg extended on a bench or ottoman with your heel supported. Keep your toes pointing downward in a relaxed position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tap your toes upward repeatedly in a controlled manner, focusing on engaging the anterior tibialis muscle. Maintain your heel position without moving your leg.

exercises.name: Towel Curl - Foot
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with bare feet on a flat surface with a towel placed lengthwise in front of you. Rest your foot on one end of the towel with toes relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl your toes to scrunch and pull the towel toward you, using only your foot and ankle muscles. Repeat the scrunching motion to draw the entire towel toward your body.

exercises.name: Towel Curls
exercises.pose_description: Seated in a chair with feet flat on the floor and a small towel laid flat beneath the toes. The toes scrunch and grip the towel, pulling it toward the heel in a curling motion. The heel remains firmly on the floor throughout, and the ankle does not move — only the toes actively work to gather the towel.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person remains seated upright in the chair with feet flat on the floor, but the towel is now bunched and gathered in a tight pile beneath the toes and ball of the foot, with the toes fully curled and gripping the compressed towel. The heel stays planted on the floor while the forefoot and toes show maximum flexion and contraction, with visible tension in the intrinsic foot muscles and anterior tibialis. The legs, torso, and head remain completely stationary, with all visible effort concentrated in the intensely curled toe position.

exercises.name: Towel Scrunches
exercises.pose_description: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor, placing a small towel on the ground in front of you. Keep your heel on the ground while your toes rest on the towel.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl your toes to scrunch the towel toward you, engaging the intrinsic foot muscles and supporting structures. Relax and repeat, gradually pulling more towel toward your heel.

exercises.name: Towel Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright and hold a towel vertically with both hands, with your unaffected arm raised overhead holding the top of the towel. Your affected arm is below, holding the bottom of the towel with the elbow bent.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently pull the towel downward using your unaffected arm, which causes your affected arm to move upward and backward into extension. Maintain a gentle stretch without forcing the movement.

exercises.name: Transverse Abdominis Activation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms at your sides. Relax your breathing and prepare to engage your deep core muscles.
exercises.end_pose_description: Exhale and draw your belly button inward toward your spine, engaging your transverse abdominis without holding your breath. Maintain the contraction for 5-10 seconds.

exercises.name: Tricep Extensions
exercises.pose_description: Standing upright holding a dumbbell or resistance band overhead with both hands or one hand. The elbow points toward the ceiling and the forearm lowers behind the head by bending at the elbow, then extends back to full lockout overhead. The upper arm remains stationary next to the ear, and the core is braced.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with the dumbbell or resistance band fully extended overhead, arm(s) straight with elbows locked out and aligned vertically alongside the ears. The triceps appear fully contracted and engaged, with visible definition along the back of the upper arm, while the core remains braced and the torso stable.

exercises.name: Ulnar Nerve Glide
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and the body facing forward. The affected arm is relaxed at the side with the palm facing the body.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person stands upright with the affected arm fully extended out to the side at shoulder height, the elbow straight, wrist flexed downward with fingers curling toward the palm, and the head tilted away from the extended arm. The opposite side of the torso shows slight elongation from the lateral flexion, while the extended arm's forearm muscles appear engaged from the wrist flexion position.

exercises.name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Standing or seated upright. One hand reaches behind the back or holds the seat of a chair to depress that shoulder. The head tilts toward the opposite side, bringing the ear toward the shoulder, and the free hand may gently rest on the head to add a mild overpressure. A stretch is felt along the side of the neck and upper trapezius.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person stands upright with their torso vertical and head tilted maximally toward one shoulder, bringing the ear close to that shoulder at approximately 45 degrees of lateral flexion. The opposite arm extends behind the back with the shoulder depressed downward, while the other hand rests gently on top of the head applying gentle overpressure. The upper trapezius on the stretched side appears elongated and taut along the neck-to-shoulder line.

exercises.name: Walking
exercises.pose_description: Standing upright with good posture, chin level, shoulders relaxed, and arms swinging naturally at sides. One foot is stepping forward in a natural heel-to-toe gait pattern, with the opposite arm swinging forward for counterbalance. The core is engaged and the gaze is directed forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: The camera captures one leg fully extended behind the body with the heel lifting off the ground, while the opposite leg is forward with the knee slightly bent and foot about to make contact with the ground. The arm opposite to the forward leg is swung forward to shoulder height for momentum, while the other arm swings back, with the torso remaining upright and core visibly engaged. The head stays level and forward-facing with a natural gaze direction.

exercises.name: Wall Angel
exercises.pose_description: Standing with the back, head, and buttocks flat against a wall. Arms are raised with the backs of the hands, wrists, and elbows pressed against the wall in a goalpost position. The arms slide upward along the wall toward full overhead extension and back down, maintaining constant contact between the arms and the wall throughout the arc of movement.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person stands upright against the wall with arms fully extended overhead in a straight vertical line, palms facing forward and the backs of the hands, wrists, and inner arms maintained in contact with the wall surface. The shoulders appear engaged and drawn upward, the core is visibly braced, and the entire posterior chain from heels through head remains flush against the wall, creating a continuous straight line from feet to fingertips.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Ups
exercises.pose_description: Standing approximately arm's length from a wall with hands placed flat on the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart. The body leans forward toward the wall by bending the elbows, then pushes back to the starting position. The body maintains a straight line from head to heels, with the core engaged and heels slightly lifted.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person's arms are fully extended, pushing the body away from the wall to return to the starting position, with elbows locked straight and shoulders packed back. The body forms a rigid plank line from head to heels, angled slightly away from the wall at approximately 10-15 degrees, with the core visibly engaged and heels still slightly lifted off the ground. The chest appears expanded and the shoulders are retracted, showing activation through the pectorals, shoulders, and triceps.

exercises.name: Wall Sits
exercises.pose_description: Doing a wall sit exercise: back flat against a wall, knees bent at 90 degrees in a deep squat, thighs parallel to the floor, like sitting in an invisible chair. Feet flat on the floor shoulder-width apart. Arms at sides. The hips are at the same height as the knees, NOT on the ground.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person remains stationary in an isometric deep squat position with their back firmly pressed against the wall, knees bent at 90 degrees, thighs parallel to the ground, and feet shoulder-width apart on the floor. Their hips are held level with their knees, creating the appearance of sitting in an invisible chair, with arms resting at their sides or crossed over their chest. The quadriceps, glutes, and core muscles are visibly tensed and engaged as they hold this contracted position against gravity.

exercises.name: Wall Slides
exercises.pose_description: Standing with back flat against a wall. Both arms are raised in a goalpost or W shape with elbows bent at 90 degrees, backs of hands and forearms touching the wall. Feet are close to the wall. This is NOT a pull-up — there is no bar. The person is standing against a flat wall with arms in a W shape.
exercises.end_pose_description: Standing with back flat against a wall. Both arms are raised fully overhead with elbows straight, hands and forearms still touching the wall. Arms in a Y position above the head. Shoulders fully flexed.

exercises.name: Wall Squat with Ball
exercises.pose_description: Standing with an exercise ball or stability ball placed between the mid-back and a wall. Feet are shoulder-width apart, positioned about two feet in front of the body. The body lowers into a squat by bending the knees to approximately 90 degrees while the ball rolls along the wall. The back stays pressed into the ball and the knees track over the toes.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person is in a deep squat position with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees, thighs nearly parallel to the ground, while their back remains firmly pressed against the stability ball that has rolled down the wall. Their torso is upright and stable, feet are planted shoulder-width apart pointing forward, and their quadriceps, glutes, and core muscles are visibly tensed and engaged. The person faces directly forward with a neutral head position.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
exercises.pose_description: Standing or seated with the forearm supported or the arm extended in front. The hand draws slow circles in the air by rotating at the wrist joint, moving through flexion, radial deviation, extension, and ulnar deviation in a smooth continuous motion. The forearm remains still and the movement is isolated to the wrist.
exercises.end_pose_description: The camera captures the arm extended forward at shoulder height with the wrist fully extended backward (dorsiflexion), creating a 90-degree angle between the forearm and hand, while the forearm remains rigid and still. The person faces forward with shoulders relaxed and stable, and the wrist extensors on the top of the forearm appear visibly engaged as the hand completes the upward arc of the circular motion.

exercises.name: Wrist Curls
exercises.pose_description: Seated or standing with the forearm resting on a table or thigh, palm facing up, holding a light dumbbell. The wrist curls upward, lifting the weight by flexing the wrist while the forearm remains stationary. The fingers may open slightly at the bottom and close at the top to increase range of motion.
exercises.end_pose_description: The forearm remains flat and stationary on the table or thigh while the wrist is fully flexed upward at approximately 70-80 degrees, with the dumbbell lifted toward the ceiling and the palm still facing up. The fingers are slightly spread open, and the flexor muscles of the forearm appear prominently contracted and defined. The upper body remains upright and still, with only the wrist joint showing active movement.

exercises.name: Radial/Ulnar Deviation with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down with your hand extended beyond the edge. A resistance band is wrapped around your hand.
exercises.end_pose_description: Move your hand sideways toward your thumb (radial deviation) against light band resistance, then return. Repeat the movement in the opposite direction slowly and controlled.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing downward with your hand hanging slightly off the edge. A resistance band is wrapped around your hand.
exercises.end_pose_description: Extend your wrist upward against the band resistance, lifting your hand toward the ceiling. Pause at the top before slowly lowering back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or your thigh, palm facing downward, holding a light dumbbell. Your wrist hangs slightly beyond the edge of the support surface.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly lift your hand upward by extending your wrist, raising the dumbbell toward the ceiling. Hold briefly at the top before lowering in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Standing or seated with one arm extended straight in front at shoulder height, palm facing down. The opposite hand grasps the back of the hand and gently pulls it downward, flexing the wrist. A stretch is felt along the outer forearm and wrist extensor muscles. The elbow of the stretching arm remains straight.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person stands upright with their right arm extended straight ahead at shoulder height, palm facing downward, while their left hand pulls the right hand downward with the wrist fully flexed (fingers pointing toward the ground). The right elbow remains locked in full extension, and the forearm extensors along the outer forearm are visibly tensioned and engaged as the wrist reaches maximum downward bend.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Standing or seated with one arm extended straight in front at shoulder height, palm facing up. The opposite hand grasps the fingers and gently pulls them downward and back toward the body, extending the wrist. A stretch is felt along the inner forearm and wrist flexor muscles. The elbow of the stretching arm remains straight.
exercises.end_pose_description: The person stands upright with their stretching arm extended straight ahead at shoulder height, palm facing downward with wrist fully extended backward. Their opposite hand firmly grasps their fingers and pulls them toward their body, creating a pronounced backward bend at the wrist while the elbow remains locked and straight. The inner forearm and wrist flexor muscles appear visibly taut and elongated.

exercises.name: Wrist Isometric Strengthening
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand hanging off the edge in a neutral position. Use your opposite hand to provide gentle resistance.
exercises.end_pose_description: Apply gentle pressure to resist wrist extension, flexion, radial deviation, and ulnar deviation for 6 seconds each without allowing movement. This builds stabilizer strength safely.

exercises.name: Wrist Pronation and Supination
exercises.pose_description: Seated or standing with the elbow bent at 90 degrees and held at the side, or the forearm resting on a table. Holding a light hammer or weight, the forearm rotates so the palm turns face down (pronation) and then face up (supination). The elbow remains stationary and the movement is isolated to the forearm rotation.
exercises.end_pose_description: The forearm is fully pronated with the palm facing downward and the hammer/weight pointing toward the ground, or fully supinated with the palm facing upward and the hammer/weight pointing toward the ceiling. The elbow remains bent at 90 degrees and locked at the side of the body, with visible tension in the forearm flexors and extensors at the end range of rotation. The upper arm and torso remain completely still, isolating the movement to the rotated forearm.

exercises.name: Wrist Radial and Ulnar Deviation
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in a neutral position, holding a light dumbbell vertically like a hammer. Your wrist is in a neutral starting position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Move your hand sideways toward your thumb (radial deviation) or toward your pinky finger (ulnar deviation) in controlled motions. Work through a comfortable range without forcing the movement.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curls on Machine
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on the hamstring curl machine with your knees just below the pad edge and ankles under the lever. Your hips should be flat against the bench.

exercises.name: Knee Extension with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit on a bench or chair with a resistance band looped around your foot and held in your hands. Keep your back against the support with your leg slightly bent.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, hands resting on a support bar or wall for light balance assistance. Keep your core engaged and posture tall.

exercises.name: Knee Flexion Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your back flat and relaxed against the ground.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curls with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright and loop a resistance band around both feet while holding the band ends for stability. Keep a slight bend in both knees.

exercises.name: Clamshells with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your side with both knees bent at 45 degrees and a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your feet together.

exercises.name: Quadriceps Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright on one leg with good balance, using a wall or chair for support if needed. Keep your core engaged.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with one leg extended on the floor and loop a resistance band around the foot of the opposite leg. Keep that leg straight.

exercises.name: Quadriceps Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright next to a wall or chair for balance, with weight evenly distributed on both feet. Look straight ahead with good posture.

exercises.name: Seated Knee Extensions
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with back support, feet flat on the floor and knees at 90 degrees. Engage your core to maintain good posture.

exercises.name: Step-Ups (Low Step)
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a low step, curb, or bottom stair (2-4 inches high) with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Maintain upright posture with shoulders back.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walks with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent. Maintain an upright torso throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Monster Walks with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand holding a dumbbell at chest height with feet hip-width apart and knees bent slightly in a quarter-squat position. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine.

exercises.name: Clamshells with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent to 45 degrees and a resistance band looped around your thighs. Keep your feet together and your core engaged.

exercises.name: Step-Ups with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a low step or bench with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Maintain upright posture and engage your core.

exercises.name: Scapular Squeeze
exercises.pose_description: Stand with good posture, arms at your sides with elbows bent to 90 degrees and forearms pointing forward. Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet 6 inches away, with your arms at shoulder height and elbows bent to 90 degrees against the wall. Keep your lower back pressed against the wall.

exercises.name: Scapular Squeezes with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and hold a light dumbbell in each hand at chest height with elbows bent. Your shoulders should be relaxed and in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides. Bring your affected arm across your body at shoulder height with the elbow slightly bent.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height. Hold the resistance band with both hands, keeping your arms parallel to the ground with a slight bend in your elbows.

exercises.name: Prone I-Y-T Raises with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or table with your chest off the edge and your arms hanging down. Hold the resistance band in both hands with your arms at your sides.

exercises.name: Pendulum Shoulder Circles
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and bend forward at the hips so your torso is nearly parallel to the ground, supporting yourself with your unaffected arm on a table or chair. Let your affected arm hang freely downward in a relaxed position.

exercises.name: Cervical Retraction
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your eyes looking straight ahead and your shoulders relaxed. Your neck is in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Dead Bug with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with your arms extended straight up toward the ceiling holding a light dumbbell with both hands, and your hips and knees bent at 90 degrees. Your lower back is neutral against the floor.

exercises.name: Bird Dogs
exercises.pose_description: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Engage your core to prevent any sagging in the lower back.

exercises.name: Quadriceps Sets
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with one leg extended and the other knee bent with a rolled towel underneath. Keep your lower back neutral against the floor.

exercises.name: Supine Marching with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. A resistance band is looped around both feet, and your hands are behind your head for light neck support.

exercises.name: Child's Pose with Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Begin on hands and knees, then sink your hips back to your heels with arms extended forward on the floor. Rest your forehead toward the ground.

exercises.name: Wall Angels
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet about 6 inches away, and arms at shoulder height in a goalpost position. Keep your head, shoulders, and lower back in contact with the wall.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Flexion with Knee Extension
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Keep your lower back neutral and relaxed.

exercises.name: Monster Walk
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above your knees, feet hip-width apart. Maintain a slight knee bend and neutral spine throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Side Plank with Hip Drop
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your side propped up on your forearm, with legs stacked and your body forming a straight line from head to feet. Engage your core and keep your hips lifted off the ground.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped just below your knees, maintaining a quarter-squat position with knees bent. Keep your chest up and core engaged.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Lift your right foot slightly off the ground while keeping your left foot planted.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back on a mat with both legs extended. Pull one knee toward your chest while keeping the opposite leg straight on the floor.

exercises.name: Clamshells with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees, with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your feet together and aligned.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees, feet hip-width apart. Maintain a slight bend in both knees with good posture.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep your feet together and hands on your hips for balance.

exercises.name: Towel Curls for Foot Intrinsics
exercises.pose_description: Sit in a chair with your bare foot flat on the floor on top of a small towel or cloth. Your foot should be relaxed with toes extended naturally.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance with Band Support
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands, securing it to a sturdy object or wall mount at shoulder level. Your feet are hip-width apart.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance on Unstable Surface
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg with your hands on your hips or extended for light balance assistance. Keep your core tight and your standing leg slightly bent at the knee.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance on Stable Surface
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent, arms at your sides or extended for balance. Keep your gaze focused on a fixed point ahead.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance Hold
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides or extended for balance. Weight is evenly distributed between both feet.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance on Soft Surface
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg on a soft, unstable surface such as a cushion, folded towel, or foam pad. Keep your arms out to the sides for balance and focus your eyes on a fixed point ahead.

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening with Soft Ball
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected arm resting on your lap or table, holding a soft foam ball or stress ball in your hand. Your fingers should be relaxed around the ball.

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening with Therapy Ball
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with a soft therapy ball in your right hand, arm resting on your lap. Your hand should be in a relaxed, neutral position.

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your arm resting at your side, holding a resistance band looped in your hand with fingers relaxed around it. Your palm faces inward.

exercises.name: Isolated Finger Extension
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand relaxed in a loose fist. Keep the affected finger gently curled.

exercises.name: Warm Compress and Rest
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably in a chair with your hand resting in your lap or on a table. Prepare to apply warm, moist heat to the affected hand.

exercises.name: Passive Finger Range of Motion
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your affected hand supported on a table, palm facing down. Use your other hand to support under the affected finger.

exercises.name: Thumb Opposition Exercises
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, all fingers extended and relaxed. Keep your thumb in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles and Mobility
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your forearm supported on a table and your hand hanging relaxed off the edge. Keep your elbow stable.

exercises.name: Elbow Flexion Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with your affected arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing down. Your opposite hand is ready to assist.

exercises.name: Wrist Pronation/Supination with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or your leg, holding a light dumbbell vertically with your affected arm. Your elbow remains bent at 90 degrees and stationary throughout.

exercises.name: Gentle Wrist Flexion Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected arm extended in front of you, palm facing upward. Your opposite hand is positioned to gently assist the stretch.

exercises.name: Supine Elbow Extension with Light Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with your affected elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a light dumbbell. Your upper arm is perpendicular to your body, and your forearm points toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Nerve Gliding Exercises
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your affected arm at your side, elbow bent at 90 degrees, fist clenched. Your hand is relaxed and close to your body.

exercises.name: Forearm Pronation Isometric Hold
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm in neutral position (palm facing inward). Hold a light dumbbell with your hand.

exercises.name: Posterior Elbow Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright and place your affected arm behind your back with elbow bent. Your opposite hand gently holds your affected elbow or forearm.

exercises.name: Bicep Curls with Light Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in your affected hand with your arm extended at your side. Your palm faces forward and your elbow stays close to your body.

exercises.name: Ulnar Nerve Mobilization Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and position your affected arm at 90 degrees to your body with elbow extended. Your palm faces upward and your head is in neutral position.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexion Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Your wrist hangs slightly off the edge of the table.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your wrist hangs slightly off the edge of the table.

exercises.name: Wrist Isometric Hold
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, wrist in neutral position with palm facing sideways. Your opposite hand is positioned to provide resistance.

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening with Tennis Ball
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright holding a soft tennis ball in your affected hand with your arm resting on your lap. Your fingers are relaxed around the ball.

exercises.name: Radial and Ulnar Deviation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table and your hand hanging off the edge in neutral position. Your thumb points upward.

exercises.name: Finger Extension with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table and a resistance band looped around all your fingers. Your fingers are in a slightly flexed position.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles with Light Weight
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with your arm extended out to the side at shoulder height, holding a light weight in your hand. Your wrist is in neutral position.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexion with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Loop a resistance band around your hand just below the fingers.

exercises.name: Wrist Radial Deviation with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand in neutral position holding one end of a resistance band. The band is anchored on the ulnar side.

exercises.name: Pronation/Supination with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a resistance band attached to a fixed point. Your palm starts facing down.

exercises.name: Finger Flexion and Extension
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your hand relaxed in front of you, fingers extended straight. Your wrist is in neutral position.

exercises.name: Forearm Pronation Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your arm extended at shoulder height, palm facing down. Use your opposite hand to gently hold the back of your hand.

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening with Soft Object
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your forearm resting on a table or your lap, holding a soft sponge, stress ball, or towel in your hand. Your hand is in a relaxed open position.

exercises.name: Isometric Wrist Hold
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand hanging slightly off the edge, palm facing down in a neutral position. Your opposite hand is ready to provide gentle resistance.

exercises.name: Finger Extension with Resistance Band Alternative
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand in a relaxed fist position. Your opposite hand is positioned to gently assist.

exercises.name: Forearm Self-Massage
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected forearm resting on your lap or a table with the palm facing upward. Use your opposite hand to begin massage.

exercises.name: Elbow Flexion and Extension
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your arm at your side, elbow bent at 90 degrees with palm facing forward. Keep your upper arm stationary against your body throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Pronation and Supination
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your side, palm facing down (pronated position). Keep your upper arm stable and only rotate at the forearm.

exercises.name: Light Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing forward. Keep your elbows close to your body and core engaged.

exercises.name: Tricep Extension with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright holding a light dumbbell with both hands, raising it overhead with elbows bent at approximately 90 degrees. Your elbows should stay close to your head and relatively stationary.

exercises.name: Passive Elbow Flexion Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your right arm extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing down. Use your left hand to gently grasp your right wrist or forearm.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexion with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, palm facing up, holding a light dumbbell in your hand with your wrist in a neutral position. Keep your forearm stable and in contact with your leg.

exercises.name: Elbow Flexion Stretch with Towel
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your right arm raised overhead and bent at the elbow, so your hand drops behind your back. Relax your shoulders and maintain an upright posture.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing your thighs (neutral grip). Keep your elbows stationary close to your body.

exercises.name: Standing Balance on One Leg
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with your hand on a wall or rail for light support if needed. Both feet are on the ground, shoulder-width apart.

exercises.name: Prone Knee Flexion with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on the floor with a resistance band looped around your foot. Your arms are folded under your forehead for support.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Abduction with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. A resistance band is looped around both knees.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor. Your surgical leg is positioned on the chair.

exercises.name: Standing Balance on One Leg
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with your hand on a wall or counter for light support. Your weight is evenly distributed on both feet.

exercises.name: Supine Isometric Shoulder Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with the repaired arm positioned at 45 degrees away from your body, elbow slightly bent. Your forearm points upward toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Abduction Slide
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both arms at your sides, palms facing down on the surface. Your shoulders are relaxed and in neutral alignment.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Flexion with Support
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a firm chair with both arms resting on your thighs. Your spine is straight and your core is gently engaged.

exercises.name: Standing Postural Alignment
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms hanging naturally at your sides. Notice your current shoulder position and posture.

exercises.name: Supine Chest Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with your repaired arm positioned out to the side at 90 degrees, elbow slightly bent. Your uninvolved arm rests across your body.

exercises.name: Seated Elbow Flexion Active Assist
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your repaired arm resting on your lap, elbow extended. Your uninvolved arm is positioned nearby to provide assistance.

exercises.name: Supine Prone Walk
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both arms at your sides, legs extended. Your core is gently engaged and your spine maintains neutral alignment.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Deadlifts (Light)
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms straight. Keep your chest up and shoulders back.

exercises.name: Supine Knee Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor or a bed. Keep your pelvis neutral and relaxed.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Abduction with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexion with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright facing a stable surface for light support, with a resistance band looped around one foot. Keep your standing leg straight with a slight knee bend for stability.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Internal/External Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with one hip and knee bent to 90 degrees, with a light resistance band around the thigh. Keep your lower back neutral and engaged.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Adduction with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band around both thighs above the knees.

exercises.name: Sidelying Hip Abduction with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your side with legs extended and stacked, with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep your core engaged and head resting on your arm.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Extension with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a stable surface with a resistance band looped around one foot, keeping your posture upright. Engage your core and hold the support surface lightly.

exercises.name: Figure-4 Stretch with Band Assist
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with one knee bent and crossed over the opposite thigh in a figure-4 position. Place a band around the thigh of the bottom leg for gentle assistance.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Shrugs
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms at your sides with palms facing down. Your shoulders are relaxed and in neutral position.

exercises.name: Supine Elbow Flexion with Arm Support
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and the affected arm resting at your side with elbow extended. Place a small pillow under the affected arm for support.

exercises.name: Standing Wall Slides
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet 6 inches away from the wall, and arms at shoulder height with elbows bent 90 degrees. Your forearms are parallel to the ground.

exercises.name: Seated Torso Rotations
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands crossed loosely over your chest. Your hips remain stable and facing forward.

exercises.name: Lying Affected Side Rotation with Pillow
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with hips and knees slightly bent for stability, and place a pillow between your knees. Your affected arm is bent at the elbow and rests on your torso.

exercises.name: Seated Chin Tucks
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with good posture, eyes looking straight ahead, and shoulders relaxed. Your spine is neutral and supported against the chair back.

exercises.name: Cervical Isometric Holds
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Place your hand gently against the side of your head at temple level.

exercises.name: Scapular Squeeze with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward. Keep your neck in a neutral position with minimal movement.

exercises.name: Supine Dumbbell Chest Press
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and dumbbells held at chest level with elbows at 90 degrees. Ensure your head and neck remain supported and neutral.

exercises.name: Supine Bridge
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Keep your neck relaxed and head supported by the floor.

exercises.name: Gentle Finger Flexion Exercises
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Keep your wrist in a neutral position with fingers fully extended.

exercises.name: Supination and Pronation
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked against your side, holding a light weight or object in your hand. Start with your palm facing down.

exercises.name: Scar Tissue Mobilization
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, gently exposing the surgical incision site on your wrist or palm. Use your opposite hand to apply light pressure.

exercises.name: Active Wrist Radial Deviation
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in a neutral position, palm facing downward. Keep your hand relaxed with fingers extended.

exercises.name: Towel Grip and Release
exercises.pose_description: Sit with a rolled towel on a table in front of you. Place your open hand flat on top of the towel with fingers extended and relaxed.

exercises.name: Thumb Opposition Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm facing upward with all fingers extended. Keep your wrist in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your legs extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot with your heel resting on the ground.

exercises.name: Supine Ankle Dorsiflexion with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with legs extended and a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot. Keep your heel on the surface with your foot in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Supine Gluteal Bridge
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Position feet approximately 12 inches from your buttocks.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Sets with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your knee and the other end anchored low behind you. Keep your knee slightly bent and core engaged.

exercises.name: Standing Supported Marching
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall or sturdy surface with both hands lightly supporting yourself. Distribute your weight evenly on both feet with good posture.

exercises.name: Prone Hip Extension with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a comfortable surface with a resistance band looped around both feet. Rest your forehead on your arms to maintain neutral spine alignment.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with one leg extended in front of you and the other knee bent with foot on the floor. Place a resistance band around the ball of your extended foot, holding both ends.

exercises.name: Prone Hamstring Isometric Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a firm surface with legs extended straight behind you. Place your forehead on your hands for comfort and support.

exercises.name: Supine Bridge Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Arms are at your sides with palms down.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold
exercises.pose_description: Sit on the floor with both legs extended in front of you. Keep your spine tall and shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Hinge
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine.

exercises.name: Supine Glute Activation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned directly under your knees. Arms are at your sides.

exercises.name: Quadruped Leg Lift
exercises.pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.

exercises.name: Tibialis Anterior Strengthening
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees. Your back is against the chair and core is engaged.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walks with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, knees slightly bent in a quarter-squat position. Your chest is up and core is engaged.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Lifts
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your back against the backrest, feet flat on the floor, and knees bent at 90 degrees. Your posture is tall and core engaged.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretches
exercises.pose_description: Kneel on one knee with the other leg stepped forward, foot flat on the ground. Keep your torso upright.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Internal Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side, holding a resistance band with both hands. Keep your upper arm stationary against your ribcage throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Horizontal Abduction
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you at shoulder height, holding a resistance band stretched between your hands. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Row
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart on a resistance band, holding the ends with both hands and arms extended downward in front of you. Maintain a neutral spine and slight knee bend throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Doorway Shoulder Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand in a doorway with your right arm raised to 90 degrees and forearm resting against the doorframe. Position your body so you face the doorframe.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Stand on a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ends at your sides with arms extended downward. Maintain good posture with shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Lateral Raise
exercises.pose_description: Stand on a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ends at your sides with arms extended downward and a slight elbow bend. Keep your core engaged and posture upright.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder External Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with your affected shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, palm facing your head. Keep your upper arm perpendicular to your body.

exercises.name: Prone Shoulder I-Y-T Raises
exercises.pose_description: Lie face-down with your forehead resting on a rolled towel and arms at your sides with palms facing down. Engage your core to stabilize your torso.

exercises.name: Scapular Wall Slides
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall with feet about 12 inches away, knees slightly bent. Place your arms against the wall at shoulder height with elbows bent to 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Prone Shoulder Blade Squeezes
exercises.pose_description: Lie face-down with your forehead on a rolled towel and arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your legs straight and relaxed on the ground.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Blade Retractions
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your arms at 90 degrees to your body with elbows slightly bent and palms facing up.

exercises.name: Posterior Shoulder Doorway Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand in a doorway with your affected arm raised and forearm against the doorframe at 90 degrees. Position your elbow at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a dumbbell resting across your hips. Your arms should be at your sides with palms down for stability.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlift with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright on your left leg holding a dumbbell in your right hand at your side with a slight knee bend. Keep your core engaged and shoulders back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms extended. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine with a slight forward hinge at the hips.

exercises.name: Pallof Press with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands, perpendicular to your torso. Keep your core tight and shoulders squared forward.

exercises.name: Quadruped Hip Circle
exercises.pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with a neutral spine, wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Lift one knee slightly off the ground.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side with your arm extended, shoulders level and squared. Engage your core to prevent side bending.

exercises.name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the ends in your hands.

exercises.name: Lateral Ankle Inversion with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended or bent at the knee. Loop a resistance band around the forefoot and hold the ends with your hands.

exercises.name: Lateral Ankle Eversion with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended or bent at the knee. Loop a resistance band around the forefoot and hold the ends with your hands.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance on Foam Pad
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright on a foam balance pad or unstable surface with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides. Distribute your weight evenly on both feet.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Adduction
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with both legs extended and a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your torso stable and core engaged.

exercises.name: Prone Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie face-down on the floor with your forearms supporting your upper body. Bend one knee and bring that foot toward the opposite side of your body.

exercises.name: Seated Figure-4 Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on the floor with both legs extended in front of you. Bend one knee and place that ankle across the opposite leg's thigh, forming a figure-4 shape.

exercises.name: Finger Isolation Lifts
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down with fingers extended. Keep all fingers relaxed and in contact with the table.

exercises.name: Forearm Pronation and Supination
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your body, palm facing up (supinated position). Keep your forearm steady.

exercises.name: Upper Extremity Pendulum Swings
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your affected arm hanging relaxed at your side. Bend slightly at the waist to allow your arm to swing freely.

exercises.name: Neck and Shoulder Relaxation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with good posture. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your arms resting in your lap.

exercises.name: Step-Ups with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a step or low platform (12-18 inches) holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Plant your foot firmly on the step with your whole foot making contact.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlifts with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg while holding dumbbells at your sides, with a slight bend in your standing knee. Your non-working leg is relaxed and your gaze is fixed forward to maintain balance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunges
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart and your weight evenly distributed. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Prone I-Y-T Raises
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or floor with arms at your sides and forehead resting on a towel. Your legs are extended with toes on the ground for stability.

exercises.name: Neck Isometric Holds
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with good posture and your hands placed against the side of your head. Your neck is in a neutral position looking straight ahead.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck Flyes
exercises.pose_description: Sit on a reverse pec deck machine with your chest against the pad and hands gripping the handles at shoulder height. Your shoulders are relaxed and arms are bent slightly.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Rows
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor and loop a resistance band around a fixed point at chest height. Hold both ends of the band with arms extended forward at shoulder width.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pull-Aparts
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band with both hands at shoulder height, arms extended in front of you. The band should be taut but not stretched at the starting position.

exercises.name: Upper Back Strengthening with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a looped resistance band at waist level with both hands. Your arms should be straight down with a slight bend at the elbows and the band at rest.

exercises.name: Scapular Retractions
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your back against a chair or wall, arms at your sides with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Hold a resistance band with both hands, maintaining slight tension in the band.

exercises.name: Posterior Neck Stretch with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around the back of your head at about ear level, holding both ends of the band in your hands. Keep your neck in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Thoracic Extension with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around your upper back at shoulder blade height, holding both ends across your chest. Your shoulders should be relaxed and your spine neutral.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Reverse Fly
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bent knees, holding a resistance band with both hands at waist level in front of your body. Your arms should be extended straight with a slight bend at the elbows.

exercises.name: Scapular Squeeze (Prone)
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a firm surface with arms at your sides, palms facing down. Your forehead rests on a rolled towel to keep your neck neutral.

exercises.name: Seated Upper Back Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Clasp your hands together in front of your chest.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Blade Retraction
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Arms are extended straight up toward the ceiling with palms facing each other.

exercises.name: Thoracic Spine Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Your spine is neutral and core is engaged.

exercises.name: Cervical Retraction with Resistance
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and place your hand against your chin. Your neck is in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Thoracic Spine Extension Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and clasp your hands behind your head with your elbows wide. Your feet are flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrugs
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Your shoulders are relaxed and your chest is up.

exercises.name: Postural Wall Hold
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall with heels, glutes, and shoulders all touching the wall. Your neck should be in neutral alignment with your head also touching the wall.

exercises.name: Neck Isometric Hold
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with perfect posture and place your hand against one side of your head. Your neck is in a neutral position.

exercises.name: Prone Hip Extensions
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on the floor with your forehead resting on your hands and legs extended straight behind you. Keep your core engaged to prevent lower back arching.

exercises.name: Quadriceps Stretching
